questions.question: Although the company had been in financial difficulties for some time, it was not until the bank withdrew its support that their problems became acute.
options: It wasn't until the bank withdrew its support that their problems became acute.
Their problems became acute although the bank withdrew its support.
The bank's withdrawal of support made their problems become acute.
They had been in financial difficulties for some time when the bank withdrew its support.
questions.answer: It wasn't until the bank withdrew its support that their problems became acute.

questions.question: What would have happened if the new policy had been implemented last year?
options: Had the new policy been implemented last year, what would have happened?
If the new policy had been implemented last year, it is likely that...
The new policy was not implemented last year because what would have happened.
What would have happened if the new policy were to be implemented next year?
questions.answer: Had the new policy been implemented last year, what would have happened?

questions.question: It is essential that all employees are aware of the company's policies and procedures.
options: All employees must be aware of the company's policies and procedures.
It is necessary for all employees to be aware of the company's policies and procedures.
The company's policies and procedures should be made known to all employees.
Employees are required to be aware of the company's policies and procedures.
questions.answer: All employees must be aware of the company's policies and procedures.

questions.question: The manager was not present at the meeting, nor was he available by phone.
options: Although the manager was not present at the meeting, he was available by phone.
Neither the manager nor anyone else was present at the meeting.
The manager was present at the meeting, but he was not available by phone.
It was not until later that the manager became available.
questions.answer: Neither the manager nor anyone else was present at the meeting.

questions.question: I wish I had studied harder when I was younger, so that I might have been more successful now.
options: If only I had studied harder when I was younger, I would be more successful now.
I regret not studying harder when I was younger because...
It is a pity that I did not study harder when I was younger and...
Had I studied harder when I was younger, I might have been more successful now.
questions.answer: If only I had studied harder when I was younger, I would be more successful now.
